description: Data Deposit: Metro Service Accessibility in Chinese Cities (2000–2025) is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Liang Wang, Yu Guan. This dataset accompanies the paper "Urban Development Trajectories in China since 2000: A Metro Service Assessment Perspective" submitted to Nature Cities .It provides city-level aggregated metrics derived from a two-dimensional accessibility framework coupling service intensity (S1, population within 1 km of each station) with network accessibility (S2, cumulative population reachable within 30 minutes via metro). Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 82025 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
